For a 2D slice of the volume, each element at position $(i, j)$ in the input $U$ maps to position $(s_x \cdot i, s_y \cdot j)$ in the output $V$.
The values at these mapped positions are copied directly from $U$.
This process is repeated for all $p$ channels independently.
